# unifi_protect_sensor (Resource)

A UniFi Protect UP-Sense multi-sensor, identified by MAC. Configures the existing, adopted device over the private Protect API (`/proxy/protect/api/sensors/<id>`): name, mount type, paired camera, and the per-capability settings (motion, temperature, humidity, ambient light, smoke/CO alarm, leak, and status LED). `terraform destroy` removes the sensor from state and leaves it configured; set `forget_on_destroy = true` to unadopt it. **Config writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Sensor MAC address (the natural key); any separator/case is accepted and normalized. The device must be adopted. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `alarm_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the smoke/CO alarm listener is enabled.
- `camera` (String) Object id of the camera paired to this sensor.
- `forget_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, `terraform destroy` unadopts (forgets) the sensor instead of just removing it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `humidity_enabled` (Boolean) Whether humidity alerting is enabled.
- `humidity_high` (Number) High relative-humidity alert threshold (%).
- `humidity_low` (Number) Low relative-humidity alert threshold (%).
- `humidity_margin` (Number) Humidity hysteresis margin (%).
- `leak_external_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the external leak-probe input is enabled.
- `leak_internal_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the internal (onboard) leak sensor is enabled.
- `led_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status LED is enabled.
- `light_enabled` (Boolean) Whether ambient-light alerting is enabled.
- `light_high` (Number) High ambient-light alert threshold (lux).
- `light_low` (Number) Low ambient-light alert threshold (lux).
- `light_margin` (Number) Ambient-light hysteresis margin (lux).
- `motion_enabled` (Boolean) Whether motion detection is enabled.
- `motion_sensitivity` (Number) Motion sensitivity (0–100).
- `mount_type` (String) Physical mount type: `door`, `window`, `garage`, `leak`, or `none`.
- `name` (String) Sensor display name.
- `temperature_enabled` (Boolean) Whether temperature alerting is enabled.
- `temperature_high` (Number) High temperature alert threshold (°C).
- `temperature_low` (Number) Low temperature alert threshold (°C).
- `temperature_margin` (Number) Temperature hysteresis margin (°C).

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `id` (String) Protect object id (24-hex). Import key.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the sensor is adopted by this console.
- `is_motion_detected` (Boolean) Whether motion is currently detected.
- `is_opened` (Boolean) Whether the door/window/garage contact currently reads open.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `state` (String) Connection state.
- `type` (String) Device type identifier.
